feedback.reason: The correction reference is conditional on invoice type, so validity cannot be decided by a flat list of nullable constructor arguments.

details.mechanismOrProperty: A replacement builder can expose a correction stage and refuse completion until it has the reference.
details.scenarioApplication: The issue service only receives the completed invoice; it cannot observe the partially assembled replacement.
details.errorCorrection: The caller would have to duplicate the conditional completeness rule before issue. Null slots cannot distinguish a new issue from a replacement that still lacks its required reference. That allows an issued replacement to escape before its required provenance is present.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: This staging is warranted by the different completeness rule for replacement issues, not by the word “invoice.”
details.transfer: Model construction phases around fields that become required under the selected case.

feedback.reason: Hazard status changes the request’s required fields, so construction must validate the conditional requirement before the carrier call.

details.scenarioApplication: No carrier label is emitted until the request is complete under its selected classification.
details.errorCorrection: The constructor accepts an invalid hazardous request with no certificate. The carrier would receive a document produced from incomplete classification. A global lookup does not bind the certificate to this parcel request.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: The certificate rule is a case-specific input dependency; it does not imply every shipping object needs a builder.

feedback.reason: The scheduler cannot decide capacity from a partial booking; all three inputs must be available before it records one.

details.mechanismOrProperty: The staged draft gathers the fields, and completion runs the capacity check before exposing a Booking.
details.scenarioApplication: If the attendee count is too large, construction ends without recording a booking.
details.errorCorrection: That can reserve a time before the complete attendee count is known. A live booking can temporarily omit the values needed for the capacity check. Late parsing postpones required validation until after the record is stored.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: If the product later permits tentative holds, define that separate state instead of treating an incomplete draft as a confirmed Booking.
details.transfer: Place validation at the point where all required construction inputs are present and before the object is published.

messages.text: That can reserve a time before the complete attendee count is known.

feedback.reason: Preset validity depends on the earlier model choice, so construction should not accept the three values as independent inputs.

details.errorCorrection: A preset can be incompatible with the model selected later. The stated system treats an installation without a preset as unusable. The caller can supply a preset that is not offered for the selected model.
details.boundaryOrTradeoff: The builder owns configuration completeness, not the projector’s runtime command behavior.

feedback.reason: The export’s two inputs are order-dependent: the manifest must reference the captured revision and chosen format.

feedback.reason: The chosen team determines the deadline, so the order of those construction decisions matters.

details.mechanismOrProperty: The builder derives the deadline after team selection and exposes the record only when the pair is complete.
details.scenarioApplication: The receiver cannot get an escalation with a missing or mismatched deadline.

feedback.reason: The promotion is optional, but when present it must satisfy a relation to the base price.

feedback.reason: The split plan is valid as a whole, not line by line; its total is known only when construction is complete.
